title: OpenAI hires second sales executive from SpaceX in a month
source_used: Bloomberg report as relayed by Seeking Alpha on TradingView
key_facts: OpenAI appointed Ismail Elmas as vice president of sales for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Bloomberg reported.
It is OpenAI's second sales hire from SpaceX since September.
Elmas, based in Munich, previously worked at coding startup Cursor, which SpaceX acquired for $60 billion in August.
OpenAI hired Brian McCarthy, another senior Cursor executive, as vice president of worldwide sales last month.
OpenAI wants to expand in Europe, where officials are increasingly reluctant to rely on US technology companies.
It is preparing for a potential public listing and wants more enterprise and advertising revenue.
